description: This file defines a Java interface 'MixTaxonomyReadPlatformService' with methods for retrieving 'MixTaxonomyData' objects, used as part of a service layer in the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: MixTaxonomyReadPlatformService
classes.description: A Java interface providing methods to retrieve MixTaxonomyData objects, including retrieving all entries and retrieving a single entry by ID.

methods.name: retrieveAll
methods.description: Retrieves a list of all MixTaxonomyData objects.

methods.name: retrieveOne
methods.description: Retrieves a single MixTaxonomyData object by its ID.
